items.title: Interlocking Chevron Line DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Screens
items.description: Free for CNC and laser use, tightly packed horizontal lines bend into interlocking hexagonal chevron shapes across the entire panel, creating a rippling optical texture. The fine line spacing gives this design a woven, almost basket-like appearance from a distance.

items.title: Free Peacock Medallion Oval DXF Panel for Laser Screens
items.description: A stylized peacock is set within a tall oval medallion, itself framed by a decorative scrollwork border. The oval containment gives this piece a more formal, portrait-like composition compared to a free-flowing bird design, making it a good fit for symmetrical gate or screen layouts.
